text.p: -- Robertson, Stephens & Co raised earnings estimates on Sierra Semiconductor Corp and Linear Technology Corp.

-- Sierra's 1997 estimate was raised to $0.83/shr from $0.70 and 1998 was raised to $0.92 from $0.85. The investment firm said first quarter revenues and gross margins were better than expected and Sierra could see double-digit growth in Q2.

-- Linear's fiscal 1997 estimate was raised to $1.70/shr from $1.65 and fiscal 1998 went to $2.12 from $2.05 based on strong orders and a strong backlog that has grown sequentially. The investment firm expects a modest increase in revenues in June quarter.
